title: SkyrimNet SexLab
description:
Provides the actions and prompts needed to support sexlab animations in SkyrimNet.

## Features
- npc/hotkey can start sex, cuddle, punishment scenes
- ability add scene descriptions
- mini-sexgame
- Injury Engine support
- May ask/order/punish actor
- DOM support

## Required

- SexLab Framework (vanilla or P+; P+ Separate/enjoyment-wait scenes are capped so LLM scenes end)
- Papyrus MessageBox
- JContainers v4.2.13.1+
- SkyUI SE
- UIExtensions
 - UIExtensions_UITextEntryMenu_with_VR_support (VR)
- MageLight UI
 - Media Keys Fix
- Animation utilities: Pandora, XPMSSE, SL Animation Loader, Hug kill move fix for USSEP
- Ace Animations (cuddle/spooning)

changelog:
### Magelight UI
- Magelight UI 0.30.1+ can host the menus instead of Prisma UI; follows Dashboard UI scale
- Escape closes the Aid panel

### Stages follow enjoyment
- With the engine on, stages follow the lead actor's enjoyment instead of timers
- Num 5 cycles timer / pause / enjoy; Num 4 and 6 are greyed while following
- New **Stuck scene: end after** (30 s); **Stuck stage: punish after** now 15 s
- Enjoyment bars move smoothly

### Last stage and endings
- A passed orgasm check jumps to the last stage at once
- End list: Stop, Cuddle, vaginal, oral or anal. Num -/+ move, Num 6 / Enter picks
- The bar sinks after orgasm (**Afterglow drain**); scene ends ~2 s after bars hit 0
- Num 4 on the last stage returns to stage 1; Num 5 pauses
- New **Open Animation Selector** settings (off = random)

### Victim scenes
- The aggressor's orgasms end the scene and open the end list
- Only aggressors punish stuck scenes; female-only aggressors add **femdom**

### Animation filter
- Shared row: sexual, bound, rape, necro. Click cycles must / must not / any
- Bound and necro are left out unless someone is in heavy bondage / dead
- Sort pulldown and **freq** column; picks prefer described, fitting, least played
- Both women can orgasm in double dildo, tribbing and scissoring

### Mini-game, Punish, Aid
- Moves are summed up in the keep-talking nudge; new **Enjoyment budget**
- Punish can order a different act; Aid lists the most injured parts first

### SexLab P+ (untested)
- P+ 2.17+ required (2.15 crashed at scene end); an older P+ warns at load

### Skyrim VR (untested)
- **Grip + A** opens the menu (Magelight); new **VR menu button** settings

### Bug Fixes
- Crash when punishing without SkyrimNet_DOM
- Cuddle found no animations
- A new scene after a load inherited old enjoyment
- Actors added in the Description Editor couldn't be marked victim
- A list pick ran to the last stage with no orgasm; Num 4 ended the scene (SexLab 1.6x)
